note: v229 / Wave C item C3 — THE EAR SPEAKS CLAIMS. The audited final timeline build plan (docs/design/temporal-claims.md, controlling authority) makes ambient temporal capture a foundation requirement, not a late wave: §2.1 says dates, ranges, durations, ages, seasons, life-stage anchors and relative order stated in ANY conversation are usable information and that capture is not restricted to family; §6.4 says relative phrasings must be RETAINED even when they cannot yet be placed. The landmark record shape cannot express either: it belongs to a domain and carries at most one date, so a relative moment had no shape and a non-family person had no home, and both were dropped BY DESIGN. These cases drive the same one loop (`landmark_recorder.record_answer`, both modes) over completions that carry the new `claims` list beside the old ones, and pin the whole bridge: one extraction, one receipt, N claims, and not one landmark behavior changed. Deliberately NOT in landmark_fixtures.json: these are recorder and listener completions, not reference transcripts.

cases.note: Plan §6.4, and the repeal this item carries. Until v229 the listener leaf said in so many words that "the summer after we moved" is NOT a date, leave the record undated and the arithmetic will reach it later — and since a landmark record has no shape for order, "later" never came and the sentence was lost. It is now a `relative_order` claim with the anchor in the person's own words, which is a thing the fold can reach the day the anchor is dated. No date is invented to hold it.

cases.note: The bridge, read the other way. A completion that speaks ONLY the substrate's vocabulary — the shape this program is walking toward — clears `listener_heard_nothing` exactly as a landmark record does, because the question that class asks is *did anything come back*, never *did the old shape come back*. An age is a LENGTH and not a calendar position, so it is stored as one and no interval is fabricated for it (plan §6.4). The message is deliberately the shape v229's own prescreen amendment fixed — before it, this sentence fired nothing and the backstop had nothing to clear.
